description:
A-Music, Korea's top idol agency. After seven years of failing to debut here, veteran trainee Go Hye-Ri finally secures a chance through sheer effort only to have it snatched away instantly by new recruit Seo Jeong-Ha. Hye-Ri's inferiority complex explodes uncontrollably because Seo Jeong-Ha seems to have everything without effort... Then one day, through an app called Rental Shop, Go Hye-Ri's body switches with Seo Jeong-Ha's. Hye-Ri gets to live the life of Seo Jeong-Ha she'd always dreamed of!

But wait... is this really the life of the Seo Jeong-ha I knew? Something's wrong...!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
